answer: A grove of agents can resist sybils by requiring a refundable stake bonded to verifiable hardware identity before any agent earns rewards. Like a pearl forming only around a real grain of sand, each identity must prove unique device attestation plus a small locked deposit, slashed on fraud. Spawning thousands of hollow identities then costs real money and real devices, so a sybil farm's marginal profit turns negative while honest agents recover their stake.
